subject.title: [Feature]: Alibaba Model Studio Token Plan (Team Edition) provider

question: Should OpenClaw accept Alibaba Model Studio Token Plan as an official qwen provider/auth contract, with https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/94419 as the implementation path?
rationale: The implementation is bounded and in the right plugin boundary, but it adds public provider/config/auth surface that becomes an ongoing support contract.

options.title: Accept via linked PR after refresh
options.body: Resolve the PR conflict, finish provider/catalog review, and land the qwen Token Plan provider if maintainers want to own this Alibaba plan as an official surface.

options.title: Route outside bundled qwen
options.body: Decline bundled ownership and ask for an external plugin or ClawHub package if the plan is too narrow or too volatile for core-distributed provider support.

options.title: Reject the direction
options.body: Close the issue and linked PR with a product rationale if maintainers do not want first-class Token Plan support now.

recommendation.title: Accept via linked PR after refresh
recommendation.body: Resolve the PR conflict, finish provider/catalog review, and land the qwen Token Plan provider if maintainers want to own this Alibaba plan as an official surface.

likelyOwner.reason: Most directly tied to the qwen provider introduction and recent provider endpoint ownership evidence.
